objective: Repair the Founder-governed repository-repair approval lifecycle without weakening any authority boundary: extend exact proposal approval time to ten minutes, retire expired or consumed in-memory proposals before replacement, show an accurate Founder countdown and replacement path, and preserve digest binding, authenticated session and CSRF checks, one-time terminal code binding, attempt limits, disposable-only mutation, and zero canonical or GitHub authority.
completion_mandate_text: Founder mandate: implement the approved permanent repository-repair approval lifecycle, locally verify it, publish and merge it through the normal non-force pull-request workflow if checks pass, synchronize both canonical main branches, restart IRIS, and smoke-test the repaired proposal path. Codex must not type, approve, or execute the resulting repository-repair or Phase 0 graduation proposal for the Founder.
completion_exclusions: Typing, submitting, approving, or executing a repository-repair proposal or Phase 0 graduation proposal on the Founder behalf
Weakening exact statement, digest, expiry, one-time code, session, CSRF, attempt-limit, path, model, candidate-only, cleanup, or zero-authority controls
Credentials, spending, deployment, public or LAN exposure, repository administration, force-push, history rewrite, destructive data work, or unrelated changes
permitted_actions: Use the two exact isolated worktrees bound above
Reuse already materialized pinned dependencies without changing versions or lockfiles
Replace only expired or consumed in-memory repair proposal state; never replace a live unconsumed proposal
Publish and merge only after focused and full verification pass
prohibited_actions: Approve or execute the resulting repair or graduation proposal
Persist raw approval codes or binding secrets
Grant canonical repository, GitHub, deployment, credential, spending, or network authority to repository repair
Force-push, rewrite history, bypass branch protection, administer repositories, expose credentials, spend, deploy, or expose non-loopback ports

acceptance_commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/repair.test.tsx tests/local-gateway.test.ts

required_evidence: Ten-minute proposal expiry is Core-owned and exactly tested
Expired and consumed proposal state is retired before replacement while a live proposal remains non-replaceable
Founder UI displays a second-by-second countdown and an explicit replacement path after expiry
Exact statement, digest, one-time code, authenticated session, CSRF, five-attempt, candidate-only, cleanup, and zero-authority controls remain intact
Focused and full verification in both repositories
Non-force publication, pull-request checks, merged remote equality, canonical synchronization, restart, and smoke evidence without proposal execution
publisher: Codex after verification and review pass
